description.translate: Twelve sheets of paper will let me restore the study shelves and copy what we can substantiate. Write the blade's name correctly: Tears for Fears. The person who named it meant something by that. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The Hovering Inferno kept Tears for Fears when The Ranker fell. Recovering that same sword will return the Warden's captured call to the world. The blade keeps its name. Its greater awakening also requires the promises he left unfinished to be fulfilled.
